name: Insurance Reports
query:
SELECT 
    si.patient AS "PID",
    si.patient_name AS "Patient Name:data:170",
    si.name AS "Name",
    sii.item_group AS "Item Group",

    /* If invoice is insurance=1 use si.insurance, otherwise use customer (insurance company) */
    CASE 
        WHEN IFNULL(si.is_insurance, 0) = 1 THEN si.insurance
        ELSE si.customer
    END AS "Insurance:Data:200",

    SUM(sii.net_amount) AS "Total Amount:Currency:170"
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN 
    `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON si.name = sii.parent
LEFT JOIN
    `tabCustomer` c ON c.name = si.customer
WHERE 
    si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.status IN ('Unpaid', 'Paid', 'Overdue')
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from)s AND %(to)s
    AND (
        IFNULL(si.is_insurance, 0) = 1
        OR (
            IFNULL(si.is_insurance, 0) = 0
            AND c.customer_group = 'Insurance'
        )
    )
GROUP BY 
    si.patient, si.patient_name, si.name, sii.item_group,
    CASE 
        WHEN IFNULL(si.is_insurance, 0) = 1 THEN si.insurance
        ELSE si.customer
    END
ORDER BY 
    SUM(sii.net_amount) DESC;
